extDesc.message: Send pages, links, text, media and screenshots to Telegram directly through your own bot.

cmdSendScreenshot.message: Send a screenshot of the visible area

cmdSendArea.message: Select an area and send a screenshot

popupNotConfigured.message: Add your bot token and chat ID in settings first.

overlayHint.message: Drag to select an area. Press Esc to cancel.

optApiMissing.message: Access to api.telegram.org is turned off, so messages cannot be sent.

optTokenHelp.message: Paste the token, or the whole BotFather message. The token stays in this browser profile.

optChatIdHelp.message: Open your bot and send it a message, then press Find chat ID. For a group or channel, add the bot first. You can also enter the ID by hand; channels can use @channelname.

optChatSearching.message: Waiting for a message. Send any message to your bot in Telegram, or add the bot to a group or channel.

optChatNone.message: No chat found. Open your bot, press Start or send a message, then try again.

errUpdatesConflict.message: This bot has a webhook set, so chats cannot be detected. Enter the chat ID by hand.

optStep1Help.message: Open @BotFather in Telegram, send /newbot and follow the steps. It gives you a token at the end.

optSavedUnverified.message: Saved, but the token could not be verified.

optInvalidToken.message: The token format is not valid. Expected: 123456:ABC-DEF

optInvalidChat.message: The chat ID must be a number or @channelname.

optDirect.message: Download media in the browser when Telegram cannot fetch it

optDirectHelp.message: Asks for permission to read data on all sites. It is used only to download media you choose to send, up to 50 MB.

optShortcutsHelp.message: To change them, open your browser's extension shortcuts page. Chrome: chrome://extensions/shortcuts. Firefox: Add-ons Manager, gear icon, Manage Extension Shortcuts. The button below opens it.

optLanguageHelp.message: The extension name and shortcut descriptions always follow the browser language.

optDeleteConfirm.message: Delete the bot token, chat ID and all settings from this browser?

errToken.message: The bot token is not valid.

errChat.message: Chat not found. Check the chat ID and send your bot a message first.

errForbidden.message: The bot cannot write to this chat. It may be blocked or not a member.

errRate.message: Too many requests. Try again in $SECONDS$ seconds.

errTooLarge.message: The file is larger than the 50 MB bot limit.

errNetwork.message: Could not reach Telegram. Check your connection.

errUnsupportedUrl.message: This media source cannot be sent, for example a blob or streaming address.

errFetchDisabled.message: Telegram could not fetch this file. Turn on browser downloads in settings and try again.

errDownload.message: The file could not be downloaded.

errRestricted.message: The browser does not allow this action on this page.

errUnknown.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.
